name: Bedia (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue panel bearing a white lozenge throughout, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bedia (a bridge and a church on blue within a wreath).
history: Municipal flag of Bedia; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: yellow border around the blue panel
white lozenge throughout on the blue panel
Bedia arms — bridge and church within a wreath
